vlog_arc.theme: Discipline before dawn: what it actually takes to show up fully every day

beats.mon: Leo talks straight to camera about the week ahead, naming the one thing he's rebuilding: publish consistency, in the business and in life.
beats.tue: A quiet pre-sunrise shot of Leo lacing up for an Ironman training block, voiceover on why the first hour of the day sets the tone for all the rest.
beats.wed: The non-negotiable Reel: Leo reads the 'I finally have afternoons again' buyer quote, then tells the 30-second story of what building this formula was really about.
beats.thu: Leo sits with his kids for a few minutes before work and reflects on why 'present dad' is the real metric he's optimizing for, not just output.
beats.fri: A short confessional on a mistake from the early formulation days, framed as episode one of an ongoing transparency series.
beats.sat: Behind-the-scenes of race-day prep or a long training session, tying endurance to the same consistency the brand asks of its customers.
beats.sun: Leo closes the week at home, calm and unhurried, previewing next week's focus and thanking the people following the build in public.
